reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 34 original noun questions, full German sentences and all 136 offered options. Checked noun forms, meaning, unique offered answers, bilingual hints/explanations, distinct contexts, existing production/draft objectives and source provenance. Corrected Journalistin gender, distinguished Kaffeesatz/Kaffeesatzbehälter, avoided inherited literary Kaffeehaus passage and youth generalization. Deferred regional Jause, polysemous Juwel and ambiguous Kakao powder/beverage. Human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication approval pending. Follow-up editorial correction: fixed German spelling in Jubiläum hint.
